summary: @telliowkuwp I miss album art and liner notes. As a kid I didn't want to make video games, I wanted to be the person who wrote the back story in the directions (that you do not get anymore).
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @telliowkuwp I miss album art and liner notes. As a kid I didn't want to make video games, I wanted to be the person who wrote the back story in the directions (that you do not get anymore).
